decision_question: Is the due diligence file complete for committee off-take approval?

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative mining concession or license extract
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Example Mining holds copper extraction license EX-1029 for the named project in Kazakhstan until 2027-12-31.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative certified ore assay report
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Copper sample EX-B17 for the named Kazakhstan project reports 24% Cu; sample identity and laboratory authenticity require review.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative beneficial ownership due diligence
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Example Mining is owned by Example Holding (100%); the ownership chart and identities require authentication.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative export quota and permit clearance
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. EX-P17 records the reviewed copper shipment scope from Kazakhstan. Permit applicability and issuing authority require counsel review.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative responsible sourcing due diligence
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Review covered human rights, worker safety, grievance process and environmental risks for the named project; findings require follow-up.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative processing and refining tolling agreement
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Example Smelter agrees to process project batch EX-B17; delivery specifications and capacity commitments require contract review.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative chain of custody records
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Batch EX-B17 moves from Example Mining to Example Smelter. Transfer record EX-T17 links mine sample to processor receipt.

supplied_sources.title: Illustrative regulatory applicability memo
supplied_sources.excerpt: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. Counsel records the destination, material form, parties and applicable-rule questions for this copper dossier; no legal clearance is granted by this example.

assumptions: Synthetic training example. Documents, issuers and counterparties are fictional; no verification or approval is implied.
